Paused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is triggered by `account`.

Unpaused(address).details: Emitted when the pause is lifted by `account`.

params._academicManagerContractAddress: The address of the StudentAcademicManager contract.
params._identityContractAddress: The address of the Identity contract.

createExam(bytes32,bytes32,string,uint25.details: Creates a new exam entry. Only an Admin or Owner can create exams.

params._courseId: The ID of the course this exam belongs to (from CourseManagement.sol).
params._examDate: The timestamp of the exam date.
params._examId: A unique identifier for the exam. This ID is chosen by the caller.

returns._0: The ID of the newly created exam.

deactivateExam(bytes32).details: Deactivates an exam, preventing further student registrations or result submissions.

params._examId: The ID of the exam to deactivate.

getExam(bytes32).details: Retrieves the full details of a specific exam.

returns.courseId: The ID of the course this exam belongs to.
returns.examDate: The timestamp of the exam date.
returns.examId: The unique identifier of the exam.
returns.isActive: True if the exam is active.
returns.students: An array of student addresses registered for this exam.
returns.title: The title/name of the exam.

getExamResult(bytes32,address).details: Retrieves the result of a specific student for a given exam.

getExamStatistics(bytes32).details: Retrieves statistics for a specific exam, including total students, pass rate, and average score.

returns.averageScore: The average score of all students with results.
returns.passRate: The percentage of students who passed (score >= 60).
returns.totalStudents: The total number of students who have results for this exam.

getUserExams(address).details: Retrieves a list of exam IDs associated with a specific user (institution/admin or student). Institutions/Admins get exams they created. Students get exams they are registered for.

returns._0: An array of bytes32 containing exam IDs.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Pauses the contract, preventing certain state-changing operations. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can pause the contract.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

registerStudentsForExam(bytes32,address[.details: Registers students for a specific exam. Only an Admin or Owner can register students. Each student must exist and be a verified student in the Identity contract.

params._studentAddresses: An array of student addresses to register.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

submitResult(bytes32,address,uint256,str.details: Submits the result for a student in a specific exam. Only an Admin or Owner can submit results. After recording the result, it calls `assignGrade` in `StudentAcademicManager.sol` to update the student's overall academic performance.

params._grade: The letter grade for this specific exam.
params._notes: Any additional notes about the result.
params._score: The score obtained by the student.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

unpause().details: Unpauses the contract, allowing previously restricted state-changing operations. Only the owner (University) or an Admin can unpause the contract.

updateExam(bytes32,string,uint256,bool).details: Updates the details of an existing exam. Only an Admin or Owner can update exam details.

params._examId: The ID of the exam to update.
params._newIsActive: The new active status of the exam.
params._newTitle: The new title of the exam.
